posts.name: Uday
posts.cooked:
I am bit confused about how to proceed for the OPPE, is it like that first I need to open the exam link and read all the instructions and agree and give permission to camera, location and all, after that I need to login to the course VM with the following command roll_no@se2001-oppe-room-room_no.ds.study.iitm.ac.in and start doing oppe !!!

Or is there any other way, I am really confused in this .

Or it will happen in the exam portal???

posts.name: Samprikta Malik
posts.cooked:
It is like the way you described…first log in with exam link and do the coc then login to vm oppe room and start doing oppe

No there is no other way..

And no it will not happen in exam portal..

posts.cooked: As I understand, the OPPE setup is similar like other OPPE exams except that we do not enter our answers on the exam portal but on the terminal. But wont we be violating tab restrictions on the exam portal when we switch to terminal ?
